# Seed Audio Studio

> Free, browser-based AI tool that turns an ebook chapter, scene, or script into a
> multi-voice audiobook. An LLM identifies the characters in the text and casts a
> distinct voice for each, then generates the narration with sound effects, ambience,
> and music using the ByteDance Seed Audio 1.0 model. Bring-your-own-key (fal.ai);
> nothing leaves the user's browser.

## What it does
- Ebook to audiobook: paste a chapter/scene -> get a full-cast multi-voice audiobook.
- A distinct AI voice per character (narrator, protagonist, antagonist, etc.).
- Automatic sound effects, ambience, and music woven in from the text.
- Voice cloning: upload a 30s sample and pin it as a character's reference voice.
- One-click: an LLM (via fal's OpenRouter gateway) plans characters, scenes, and effects.

## How it differs
- Most AI audiobook tools use a single narrator voice you pick manually.
- Seed Audio Studio auto-casts a different voice per character and adds effects in one click.

## Pricing
- App: free. Generation: pay fal.ai directly, ~$0.1875 per minute of audio (Seed Audio 1.0).

## Key pages
- Home / app: https://seed-audio-studio.vercel.app/

## Tech
- Seed Audio 1.0 (bytedance/seed-audio-1.0) for audio; OpenRouter (openrouter/router) for planning.
- Static SPA, runs client-side with the user's own fal.ai API key.
